rules.statement: An appeal can be taken from an order adjudicating on the satisfaction of a decree, even if it is not a final judgment in the traditional sense.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 80 is the section which confers the right of appeal in Courts of Requests cases. According to its provisions any person ' dissatisfied with any final judgment or any order having the effect of a final judgment may (excepting where such right is expressly disallowed) appeal against any such judgment or order for any error in law or in fact.'"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 80 of the Courts Ordinance, No. 1 of 1889
